reviews.title: A great product with a great price!
reviews.comment: This is my third Apevia power supply. The build quality is solid and the performance is good. The selection of cables is adequate for most all builds. The supplied documentation is a little sparse but clear. I'm very happy with this purchase
reviews.author: Dave E.

reviews.title: My first DOA, Ever
reviews.comment:
Unusable. I have a defective one - the first I've ever received in over 14 years of building/upgrading/repairing PCs. The PSU causes the motherboard to reboot at random intervals, likely something to do with a crappy 24-pin input. It seems to be triggered also by a significant load over PCIe. E.g., the 12V rail is probably bad. This is with adequate cooling. The cables are short, as well, and barely fit in a MasterBox NR200.
This was verified by using this PSU and testing repeatedly, then trying another PSU (a Corsair SFX PSU), which works without any issues at all.
